About Leon

Ten years of printing you can count on.

Leon Printing and Trading PLC is a professional printing and production company serving Ethiopia. We print for organizations, institutions, authors, businesses and individuals who need quality output on time.

From a single run of labels to a million books, our team takes each job from first discussion to final delivery.

Book printing

Educational and literary materials in bulk, with consistent quality.

Offset printing

High-volume commercial runs with sharp reproduction and low cost per copy.

Digital printing

Hardcover binding

Perfect binding

How we work

From first call to delivery

Every project follows the same four steps, so you always know where your order stands.

  1. 1Discuss. We learn your printing needs and goals.
  2. 2Plan. We review specifications and build a clear project plan.
  3. 3Produce. We print and finish with close attention to quality.
  4. 4Deliver. Your finished materials arrive on time.

Questions

Before you order

How do I get a quote?

Use the quote form above, or call us. Tell us what you want printed, how many copies, the size and binding, and when you need it.

Do you print small quantities?

Yes. Digital printing suits short runs and on-demand jobs, straight from your digital files.

Can you handle large orders?

Yes. Our offset presses handle high-volume runs, and we have printed more than one million books.

Which binding types do you offer?

Hardcover, perfect binding and spiral binding, plus finishing for folders, labels and calendars.

Where are you, and when are you open?

We are at Leon Printing and Trading PLC in Addis Ababa, open Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:30 PM.
